title: feat(ui): restart the worker and both services from System status
context:
Settings offered a dashboard restart and nothing else, so the service that
most often needs restarting could not be restarted from the UI at all.
worker_engines.py lazily imports server, so the worker holds its own copy of
server.py's module state: after new code lands, restarting only the
dashboard leaves the old code live in the worker and reads to the user as
"the fix didn't work".

System status now has a Restart row -- Dashboard, Worker, and Restart all --
with a hint naming which one a ser
